title: Ines and the Salt
author: Astrid Whitlock
blurb: Edmund Halloran, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
